fields.name: lambda
docs: Quantum coupling strength (0 = no correlation, reduces to LMSR pricing).

types.name: EigenCache
docs: Cached eigendecomposition for a market's quantum cost function.
Populated by `submit_eigendecomp` (permissionless keeper).
Read by `place_wager` and `exit_position` for quantum-correlated pricing.
Uses Vec fields with #[max_len] instead of fixed arrays to avoid
BPF stack overflow during Anchor's init serialization.
Fresh when `version == market.eigendecomp_version`.

fields.name: market
docs: The market this decomposition is for.

fields.name: eigenvalues
docs: Eigenvalues of M = (diag(q) + λK) / b, fixed-point i64.

fields.name: eigenvectors_flat
docs: Eigenvector matrix Q (row-major: entry [i*n + k] = k-th component of i-th eigenvector).
This is the TRANSPOSE of the Jacobi output (which stores eigenvectors as columns).

fields.name: num_paths
docs: Number of active curated paths when this was computed.

fields.name: version
docs: Matches market.eigendecomp_version when fresh.

fields.name: needs_refresh
docs: Set when a large trade exceeds perturbation safety threshold.
Keeper checks this flag and resubmits full eigendecomp when set.

fields.name: utilization_rate
docs: total_borrowed / total_deposits (fixed-point 6 dec)

fields.name: haircut_ratio
docs: h = min(1, vault_residual / total_profit_claims); fixed-point 6 dec

fields.name: current_shortfall
docs: USDC amount of unresolved bad debt (6 decimals)

fields.name: haircut_active
docs: True when haircut ratio H < 1.0 (quick-read flag)

fields.name: pair_shortfall_count
docs: Number of pair buffers currently in deficit

fields.name: backstop_liquidator
docs: Governance-configured fallback liquidator. system_program::ID = disabled.

fields.name: backstop_grace_period
docs: Seconds before backstop can act after health drops. Default 300.

fields.name: lmsr_alpha
docs: Alpha parameter for adaptive liquidity: b = α × Σ|q_j| (fixed-point 6 dec; default 50_000 = 0.05)

fields.name: lmsr_share_quantities
docs: Share quantities per path. Input to both LMSR and quantum cost functions.

fields.name: lambda
docs: Quantum coupling strength. 0 = no inter-path correlation (reduces to LMSR).

fields.name: eigendecomp_version
docs: Monotonic counter incremented on every trade that changes quantities.
EigenCache is fresh only when its version matches this value.

fields.name: action_alpha
docs: Alpha coefficient for price term: S = α(Δp)² + β(Δv)². Default: 700_000 (0.7)

fields.name: action_beta
docs: Beta coefficient for velocity term. Default: 300_000 (0.3)

fields.name: amplitudes
docs: Amplitude for each path. Born rule: probability ~ |ψ_i|²

fields.name: amplitude_scale
docs: Scale factor for amplitude normalization. Default: 1_000_000

fields.name: decoherence_rate
docs: Rate at which deviating paths decohere. Default: 500_000 (0.5)

fields.name: minimum_probability
docs: Minimum Born probability below which a path decoheres. Default: 10_000 (1%)
Independent of path count — always means "below X% implied probability."

fields.name: total_weighted_score
docs: Sum of (composite_score × total_wagered) across all surviving paths.
Populated by score_path instruction during settling phase.

fields.name: paths_scored
docs: Number of paths that have been scored during settling.

fields.name: paths_dissolved
docs: Number of dissolved paths (incremented in check_dissolution).

fields.name: cumulative_action
docs: Cumulative action S = Σ[α(Δp)² + β(Δv)²] across checkpoints. Lower = better.

fields.name: composite_score
docs: Final composite score (0 to 1_000_000). Set during settlement.

fields.name: peak_amplitude
docs: Highest amplitude this path reached (for decoherence payout ratio)

fields.name: amplitude_at_decoherence
docs: Amplitude when path was marked decohered (0 if still alive)

fields.name: checkpoints_processed
docs: Number of checkpoints processed via check_dissolution (must equal
total_checkpoints for score_path to accept this path)

fields.name: collateral
docs: Actual USDC deposited (after entry fee)

fields.name: leverage
docs: 1 for Mode 1; 2-50 for Mode 2

fields.name: notional_exposure
docs: collateral × leverage

fields.name: lmsr_shares
docs: Shares held via LMSR pricing

fields.name: cost_basis
docs: Total USDC paid for shares (for P&L tracking)

fields.name: health_factor
docs: Effective collateral / estimated loss (fixed-point 6 dec)

fields.name: liquidation_threshold
docs: Health factor below which liquidation triggers (1_100_000 = 1.1)

fields.name: price
docs: Price in quote decimals (USDC = 6 decimals)

fields.name: confidence
docs: Pyth confidence interval (normalized to 6 decimals)

fields.name: pyth_verified
docs: True — price was verified via Pyth Receiver Program (account owner check).
The raw Pyth signature is verified upstream by the Pyth receiver; we don't
store it on-chain (saves 64 bytes per checkpoint).

fields.name: sampled_by
docs: Keeper address (for reward distribution)

fields.name: sampled_at_slot
docs: Solana slot for ordering verification

fields.name: low_confidence
docs: True if confidence > 2% of price; weighted at 50% in scoring

fields.name: supported_pairs
docs: Governance-managed pair whitelist

fields.name: max_fee_cap_bps
docs: Hardcoded ceiling — not governable

fields.name: market_creation_fee
docs: Market creation fee in USDC (6 decimals). Default 10_000_000 (10 USDC).

docs: A whitelisted trading pair.
